description:
Find Yelp businesses by name near a location (Yelp's search suggestions: a few per
        query); returns the aliases the other Yelp tools take.

        Cost: 1 credit per call (also when nothing matches).

        Args:
            query: Business name, e.g. 'Gary Danko'.
            location: City and region, e.g. 'San Francisco, CA' (needed to get businesses).
            limit: Results to return, 1-10 (default 10).
            cursor: `next_cursor` from a previous call for more results (1 credit).
name: yelp_search_businesses
title: Search Yelp businesses
